description_en: You can use this API to retrieve the list of skill levels for skill groups associated with a specified agent under a specified instance. You can also use this API to query the list of skill groups that the agent can be associated with but is not currently associated with
description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定坐席关联的技能组的技能等级列表，也可以使用该接口查询坐席可关联但未关联的技能组列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-skill-levels-of-user --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --is-member true --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --search-pattern skillgroup --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSkillLevelsOfUser

parameters.description_en: Indicates whether to associate with the specified agent. If true, retrieves the skill levels of skill groups associated with the agent. If false, retrieves the list of skill groups that the agent can be associated with but is not currently associated with. The default value is true.
parameters.description_zh: 是否与传入的坐席关联，如果值为true，表示获取传入的坐席关联的技能组的技能等级列表，如果值为false，表示获取坐席可关联但未关联的技能组列表。默认值为true。
parameters.help_en: Indicates whether to associate with the specified agent. If true, retrieves the skill levels of skill groups associated with the agent. If false, retrieves the list of skill groups that the agent can be associated with but is not currently associated with. The default value is true
parameters.help_zh: 是否与传入的坐席关联，如果值为true，表示获取传入的坐席关联的技能组的技能等级列表，如果值为false，表示获取坐席可关联但未关联的技能组列表。默认值为true
parameters.name: is_member

parameters.description_en: Perform fuzzy matching based on skill group name or display name. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty, which means no filtering is applied.
parameters.description_zh: 根据技能组名称或技能组展示名进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤。
